description:
1. Investment Analysis and Evaluation (Pre-investment) – accounts for 70% workload
* Develop investment/financial models and perform sensitivity analysis to assess investment returns.
* Conduct in-depth financial analysis and give advice to the stakeholders.
* Prepare presentation/deck/memorandums for the Investment committee.
* Participate in end-to-end progress, including financial modeling, market research, and legal assessment.
2. Performance review (Post-investment) – accounts for 30% workload
* Prepare and maintain the Performance tracker in terms of P&L, CAPEX budget,… to ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of funding.
* To gather insights and advise action plans to stakeholders in order to improve performance.
* Other tasks assigned by the line manager.
requirements_text:
Key Competencies
* Financial and Business Analysis: Providing fact-based information and insights to make decisions that support business strategies, achieve financial goals, and ensure future profitability
* Be a Key player in developing and evaluating business plans and forecasts, paying particular attention to risk and cost/benefit relationships
* Stays alert to internal and external business development and trends
* Understands the interaction of key business drivers
* Articulates key financial concepts and information to both financial and non-financial audiences
* Ability to see both the big picture and the details
* Agile, commercial curiosity, and business acumen.
Required Background & Attitude
Education:
* Bachelor in Finance/Accounting/Auditing
* ACCA/CPA qualification is a plus.
Seniority: 3 to 4 years experience
Language: Fluent in English
Office skills: Proficiency in MS Office, especially in Excel & PowerPoint
Other skills:
* Self-confident; Effective time management; Working under high pressure
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong organizational skills and proven ability to work independently or as a team player
* Strong numeracy skills, Financial statement analysis.

Bán lẻ - Hàng tiêu dùng - FMCG, Tài chính, Kiểm toán
